title: Hyunjin Lee and Kyunghun Lee begin graduate study at DGIST
summary: Hyunjin Lee joins the Ph.D. program, and Kyunghun Lee joins the integrated M.S./Ph.D. program.

title: Online publication on vertically integrated 2D/3D photodetectors
summary: A study of vertically integrated WS₂/MoS₂–Si photodetectors for spectrally decoupled detection and non-invasive biosignal monitoring.
body: This study investigates vertically integrated WS₂/MoS₂–Si photodetectors for spectrally decoupled detection and non-invasive biosignal monitoring.
The paper was published online in eScience on August 11, 2026. It is currently an Article in Press, ahead of assignment to a final volume and issue.

title: 2026 summer research internship concludes
summary: 석일현, 김지환, 박민주, 전재영, and 김찬주 participated in the July 6–31 summer research internship. The program included ASE, MLIP-MD, and symbolic regression tutorials, followed by team presentations.

title: Kyunghun Lee receives an Excellence Award at DGIST AI Build Week
summary: Kyunghun Lee received an Excellence Award (최우수상) at the 2026 DGIST AI Build Week Hackathon.

title: New publication on surface reconstruction of BiVO₄ photoanodes
summary: A study of band edges and lattice-oxygen reactivity on BiVO₄(010) photoanodes.
body: The study examines how surface reconstruction tunes band edges and lattice-oxygen reactivity on BiVO₄(010) photoanodes.

title: New Publication: Mechanistic Origins of Structural Failure in Deeply-Lithiated LixMoS2
summary: Published in Energy & Environmental Materials. This study explores the structural failure mechanisms in molybdenum disulfide during deep lithiation.
body: The study examines the mechanistic origins of structural failure in deeply lithiated LiₓMoS₂.

title: New Publication: Atomistic Insights into the Electrochemical Oxygen Evolution Activity of Hollandite IrO2 Surfaces
summary: Published in Advanced Science. An atomistic study of the electrochemical activity of IrO₂ surfaces.
body: The study examines the electrochemical oxygen evolution activity of hollandite IrO₂ surfaces using atomistic modeling.
The paper first appeared online on December 29, 2025; its assigned journal issue is dated 2026.
